 Saturday’s NAU Football Kickoff Versus Weber State Moved Back to 4 p.m.
 Story Links
 FLAGSTAFF, Ariz. (November 13, 2026) –  Due to the Federal Aviation Administration's grounding of flights nationwide on Friday impacting Weber State's travel to Flagstaff, Saturday's kickoff between No. 5/5 Northern Arizona and No. 18/20 Weber State will move back to 4 p.m. MST at Findlay Toyota Field at the Walkup Skydome.
All game tickets will be honored as purchased and tickets still remain for the nationally-ranked matchup at this  link .
Fans have several opportunities to enjoy the game at a discounted price. With Saturday serving as NAU's Military Appreciation Game, all veterans, active duty and retired service members will receive a 20% discount off of tickets. A valid military ID must be presented at the Lumberjack Ticket Office outside the East Entrance to the Walkup Skydome to receive the offer. Additionally, all children 12 and under will receive free admission with discounted tickets available for parents using this  link . The kids promo will also be valid at the Ticket Office on Saturday prior to kickoff.
The Walkup Skydome parking lots will open at 9 a.m. with the free, family-friendly Ponderosa tailgate opening at 1 p.m. The Lumberjack Walk will take place at 1:45 p.m. and there will be a Navy Drill Team performance in The Ponderosa at 2:15 p.m. Doors to the Skydome will open to all fans at 2:30 p.m.
Stay up to date with Northern Arizona football by following the Lumberjacks on  X  and  Instagram . Print Friendly Version
